_readme: Hand-written meaning layered over chem_stats.json (game code). Keys: full reagent path. od_severity (about HP per tick while overdosed; 2 brute/tick = 2.0), od_note, status [{name,cls,tip}] (special effects, cls = buff|debuff), buffs [{name,cls,tip}] (healing effects that are not plain damage numbers), contact.

status.name: Slick
status.tip: Floor contact: a tile with 1u or more of lube makes anyone who steps on it slip and slide. Each exposure keeps the floor lubed for 15 s plus 2 s per unit (max 120 s). Works through any clothing; nothing needs to get into the blood.

status.name: Clean
status.tip: Contact: washes the target and the floor tile (blood, grime, decals, chemical residue). The floor needs 1u or more per exposure. No damage.

status.name: Clean
status.tip: Contact: washes the target and the floor tile (blood, grime, decals, chemical residue). The floor needs 1u or more per exposure. No damage.

status.name: Ignite
status.tip: Touching it sets the target on fire. EVERY exposure adds +1 fire stack, sets them alight and deals 0.3 burn x their fire stacks (stacks cap at 20). Fire armour scales the burn damage; hardsuits do not stop the contact.

status.name: Fuel
status.tip: Contact adds fire stacks equal to units / 4 per exposure (max 20): the target burns much longer once lit. Does not ignite by itself.

status.name: Flammable
status.tip: Contact adds fire stacks equal to units / 15 per exposure.

status.name: Extinguish
status.tip: Contact puts out fire on the target and the tile and removes fire stacks.

status.name: Wet
status.tip: Contact puts out fire and adds wet stacks; a floor with 5u or more goes wet (slippery).

status.name: Scald
status.tip: Contact burn: units x 0.5 / 3 per exposure (max 25). A floor with 5u or more goes wet.

status.name: Dry
status.tip: Contact dries wet tiles and removes wetness.

status.name: Mutation
status.tip: Foam: each exposure has a (units)% chance, max 33%, of a random mutation.

status.name: Acid
status.tip: Contact melts clothing first; on bare body zones it deals brute (acid power / 2) and burn damage per exposure.

status.name: Acid
status.tip: Contact melts clothing first; on bare body zones it deals brute and burn damage per exposure.

buffs.name: Crit stabiliser
buffs.tip: Only while the target is in crit: heals 0.5 of every damage type per tick, so a person in crit is held up. Also restores breath and cuts stun time, any time.

buffs.name: Crit rescue
buffs.tip: Only while in crit: heals 2 brute, 2 burn, 2 toxin and 5 oxygen damage per tick (strong). Slight toxin damage if overdosed.

buffs.name: Crit rescue (heart)
buffs.tip: Only while in crit: heals 2 brute, 2 burn, 2 toxin and 6 oxygen damage per tick. Overdose damages the heart badly (heart attack).

/datum/reagent/medicine/c2/penthrite.od_note: Heart takes 10 organ damage per tick: heart attack in seconds.

buffs.name: Purge toxins
buffs.tip: Removes other chemicals from the blood while it is active (the "Purge" effect).

/datum/reagent/consumable/ethanol/thirte.od_note: Stuns and knocks out in bursts; short bursts, no direct damage.

/datum/reagent/drug/cannabis.od_note: No real overdose in the code.

/datum/reagent/drug/maint/tar.od_note: 5 toxin per tick plus liver damage.

/datum/reagent/toxin/histamine.od_note: 2 brute, 2 oxygen and 2 toxin per tick.

/datum/reagent/medicine/omnizine.od_note: 1.5 of each damage type per tick.
